blocks.text: After the fiercest fighting, the crisis shifts toward hunger and scarcity inside the besieged position, as grain, fodder, and even basic sustenance disappear.
The trapped force suffers so deeply that earth itself is eaten, and the page turns from sword-blows to the agony of attrition.
This is the siege reduced to survival, where bodily need begins to press harder than weapons.
